facts.fact: Kandan called Neela a witch to her face at the barracks door the week Raiu burned.
facts.why: needed because the beat says Kandan, who called her a witch, is the first to salute Devan.

facts.fact: The queen's second writ is dated eleven days before Ittan's execution and bears the sunbird seal with the chip at the left wing tip; Rema was told to open it only if Neela answered yes under oath.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the writ be dated before the execution and opened by Rema.

facts.fact: Rema tells them she will record that they left within three days and will not record where they went.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Rema warn that the queen will remember where they go.

facts.fact: Muthu swears to hold the seal for the border and the villages, not for the queen's household, Devan's house or his own.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Muthu swear to the border, not the household.
